text:
maya: Canary rollout for v2.7.0 started, but prompt-suite evals flagged a regression. hallucination up +3.8% and summarizer quality delta -0.07. Deploybot shows canary hold. link: https://re.redwood/runs/1234 RD-5423

deploybot: Canary hold triggered by eval-gate. Reasons:
 - prompt_suite.hallucination > 2%
 - summarizer.delta < -0.05
Actions: pin rollout, run bisect, or rollback to v2.6.8. To pin: /deploybot pin RD-5423. To rollback: /deploybot rollback v2.6.8

olivia: Can we get a short impact assessment? Is this affecting top customers or just edge prompts? :thinking_face:

rebecca: Quick check on telemetry for top10 customers: generation error rate +0.2% and a small uptick in hallucination flags for two internal suites. No latency regressions. Not a clear outage, but noticeable quality drop on summarizer for long docs.

qa-bot: Eval summary snippet:
```
prompt-suite:
  hallucination: baseline 1.2% -> 5.0% (+3.8)
summarizer:
  rouge-l: baseline 0.42 -> 0.35 (delta -0.07)
thresholds:
  hallucination_threshold: 2.0
  summarizer_delta_threshold: -0.05
```

maya: Proposal: pause canary promotion (pin) and run a bisect on the release branch to identify offending change. If bisect isolates a single PR within 1h, prepare a hotfix and schedule a small rollout. Ops: can we pin during today's change window (16:00-18:00 UTC)?

sanjay: Ops note: change window 16:00-18:00 UTC today — we avoid rollbacks unless Sev1. Pinning/pausing the rollout is OK. Approve pin-only action and monitoring for 30m. :white_check_mark:

olivia: Ok — we'll avoid full rollback for now. Please open RD-5423 with links to the failing prompt slices and add the mitigation checklist. Also update release notes to mention a paused canary and customer-facing monitoring.

maya: Created RD-5423 and added failing prompt examples + run links. Starting bisect now. /deploybot pin RD-5423

deploybot: Action taken: pin applied to v2.7.0 canary (RD-5423). Canary promotion paused, rollout halted at 20% traffic. Notified releasebot and oncall. To unpin: /deploybot unpin RD-5423. To rollback: /deploybot rollback v2.6.8

releasebot: Pinned: v2.7.0-canary (RD-5423) — reason: prompt-suite regression. Notifying #customer-notify if degradation exceeds alert thresholds. Slack note will be sent if top-customer impact increases >1%.

maya: Thanks. Bisect started — will update in ~45m with the suspected PR. If bisect pins to model quantization change, we'll prepare a targeted revert.

rebecca: Add a quick blurb to release notes: "Canary paused due to prompt-suite regression — investigating; no customer-facing rollback at this time." I'll coordinate comms if we see escalation.

olivia: Ops confirmed monitoring hooks — set alerts for hallucination and rouge drop. If either crosses +6% / -0.12 respectively, auto-escalate to sev2.

maya: Good. Closing loop for now — pin applied, bisect running, ops approved monitoring. Will post follow-up with root cause or rollback decision. :handshake:
